message: Populated the initial project context and operational patterns from verified repository metadata and documentation; left code grounding empty because mex 0.7.0 does not resolve the core C# symbols.
Replaced Npgsql-specific runtime parameters and PostgreSQL-only SQL in graph topology and argument suggestion paths with provider-neutral EF Core operations so SQL Server rebuilds can execute.

Fixed empty Understanding Graph rendering caused by stale session-cached skeleton manifests: always refresh the manifest and fall back to the live map API when the static skeleton is missing or empty.

Removed hardcoded database credentials and secret parameters from tracked configuration paths. Azure deployment scripts now require ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection, AzureFoundry:Endpoint, and AzureFoundry:ApiKey from the project's .NET user-secrets secrets.json; EF design-time creation now fails closed when no connection string is configured.

Added opt-in baseline content generation: canonical belief systems feed bounded Semantic Kernel generation, posts are owned by a non-login AI service account, stable source keys prevent duplicates, provenance is persisted, and each post runs through the existing social analysis pipeline.
